name: Alex Dimakis

affiliations.role: Co-founder and Chief Scientist; professor at UC Berkeley

bio: Alex Dimakis is a professor of EECS at UC Berkeley, co-director of the NSF AI Institute for Foundations of Machine Learning, and co-founder of Bespoke Labs. His work covers generative models for inverse problems, coding theory for distributed learning, and open data curation for reasoning models such as OpenThoughts and DataComp-LM.
